Northstar Labs develops the Aurora sensor platform for coastal observatories. Alice Chen leads Northstar Labs and coordinates the Aurora engineering team.

The Aurora platform exchanges telemetry with Beacon Systems through a documented interface
. Beacon Systems validates each telemetry packet before archival.

Orchid Research operates the Meridian analysis service for renewable-energy cooperatives. Mateo Silva directs Orchid Research and reviews Meridian forecasts.

Meridian shares verified summaries with Harbor Cooperative.
